name: Dexterity
insight: Raised $95M in 2025 at a $1.65B valuation; its robots load trucks for FedEx, UPS, and GXO.
tagline: Physical AI robots for warehouse manipulation and truck loading.
description: Dexterity builds 'Physical AI' robots that handle complex manipulation in logistics — including DexR, a truck-loading robot, and Mech, a two-armed mobile 'superhumanoid' that lifts up to 132 lb. Its Foresight world model is trained on over 100 million autonomous actions run in production. Customers include FedEx, UPS, GXO, and Sumitomo, and the company reached a $1.65B valuation in 2025.
